تكتسحون (form VIII)
# تَكْتَسِحُونَ (taktasiḥūna) /tak.ta.si.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
# تُكْتَسَحُونَ (tuktasaḥūna) /tuk.ta.sa.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
